databaseTree.tables: SELECT STRING(user_name, '.', table_name) AS TableName FROM SYS.SYSTABLE LEFT JOIN SYS.SYSUSER ON creator = user_id WHERE table_type = 'BASE' AND user_name NOT IN ('SYS', 'dbo') ORDER BY user_name, table_name;
databaseTree.views: SELECT STRING(vcreator, '.', viewname) AS ViewName FROM SYS.SYSVIEWS WHERE vcreator NOT IN ('SYS', 'dbo') ORDER BY vcreator, viewname;
databaseTree.procedures: SELECT STRING(user_name, '.', proc_name) AS ProcedureName FROM SYS.SYSPROCEDURE LEFT JOIN SYS.SYSUSER ON creator = user_id WHERE user_name NOT IN ('SYS', 'dbo') ORDER BY user_name, proc_name;

databaseObject.view: SELECT ISNULL( SYSTABLE.source, SYSTABLE.view_def ) AS ViewDefinition FROM SYS.SYSTABLE JOIN SYS.SYSUSER ON SYSTABLE.creator = SYSUSER.user_id WHERE SYSTABLE.table_type = 'VIEW' AND STRING( SYSUSER.user_name, '.', SYSTABLE.table_name ) = $viewName;
databaseObject.procedure: SELECT ISNULL( SYSSOURCE.source, SYSPROCEDURE.proc_defn ) AS ProcedureDefinition FROM SYS.SYSPROCEDURE JOIN SYS.SYSUSER ON SYSPROCEDURE.creator = SYSUSER.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN SYS.SYSSOURCE ON SYSPROCEDURE.object_id = SYSSOURCE.object_id WHERE STRING( SYSUSER.user_name, '.', SYSPROCEDURE.proc_name ) = $procedureName;

table.columns: SELECT CASE WHEN SYSIDXCOL.index_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PKey, SYSTABCOL.column_name AS Name, SYSTABCOL.base_type_str AS DataType, CAST( SYSTABCOL.width AS INTEGER ) AS Size, SYSTABCOL.scale AS Scale, CASE WHEN SYSTABCOL.nulls = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Nullable, SYSTABCOL.[default] AS DefaultValue FROM SYS.SYSTAB JOIN SYS.SYSUSER ON SYSTAB.creator = SYSUSER.user_id JOIN SYS.SYSTABCOL ON SYSTAB.table_id = SYSTABCOL.table_id LEFT OUTER JOIN SYS.SYSIDX ON SYSTAB.table_id = SYSIDX.table_id AND SYSIDX.index_category = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SYS.SYSIDXCOL ON SYSIDX.table_id = SYSIDXCOL.table_id AND SYSIDX.index_id = SYSIDXCOL.index_id AND SYSTABCOL.column_id = SYSIDXCOL.column_id WHERE STRING( SYSUSER.user_name, '.', SYSTAB.table_name ) = $objectName ORDER BY SYSTABCOL.column_id;
table.constraints: SELECT SYSCONSTRAINT.constraint_name AS Name, CASE SYSCONSTRAINT.constraint_type WHEN 'P' THEN 'Primary Key' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Foreign Key' WHEN 'U' THEN 'Unique' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Check' WHEN 'T' THEN 'Trigger' ELSE SYSCONSTRAINT.constraint_type END AS ConstraintType, CASE WHEN SYSIDX.[unique] = 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS [Unique], ( SELECT LIST( SYSTABCOL.column_name, ', ' ORDER BY SYSIDXCOL.sequence ) FROM SYS.SYSIDXCOL JOIN SYS.SYSTABCOL ON SYSIDXCOL.table_id = SYSTABCOL.table_id AND SYSIDXCOL.column_id = SYSTABCOL.column_id WHERE SYSIDXCOL.table_id = SYSIDX.table_id AND SYSIDXCOL.index_id = SYSIDX.index_id ) AS [Columns] FROM SYS.SYSCONSTRAINT JOIN SYS.SYSTAB ON SYSCONSTRAINT.table_object_id = SYSTAB.object_id LEFT OUTER JOIN SYS.SYSIDX ON SYSCONSTRAINT.ref_object_id = SYSIDX.object_id WHERE STRING( USER_NAME( SYSTAB.creator ), '.', SYSTAB.table_name ) = $objectName ORDER BY CASE SYSCONSTRAINT.constraint_type WHEN 'P' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 WHEN 'U' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 4 WHEN 'T' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, SYSCONSTRAINT.constraint_name;
table.referencingConstraints: SELECT DISTINCT ForSYSIDX.index_name AS Name, USER_NAME( ForSYSTAB.creator ) AS TableOwner, ForSYSTAB.table_name AS [Table], CASE WHEN ForSYSIDX.[unique] = 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS [Unique], SYSFOREIGNKEYS.columns AS [Columns] FROM SYS.SYSFKEY JOIN SYS.SYSTAB AS PriSYSTAB ON SYSFKEY.primary_table_id = PriSYSTAB.table_id JOIN SYS.SYSTAB AS ForSYSTAB ON SYSFKEY.foreign_table_id = ForSYSTAB.table_id JOIN SYS.SYSIDX as ForSYSIDX ON SYSFKEY.foreign_table_id = ForSYSIDX.table_id AND SYSFKEY.foreign_index_id = ForSYSIDX.index_id JOIN SYS.SYSIDXCOL AS ForSYSIDXCOL ON ForSYSIDX.table_id = ForSYSIDXCOL.table_id AND ForSYSIDX.index_id = ForSYSIDXCOL.index_id JOIN SYS.SYSTABCOL AS ForSYSTABCOL ON ForSYSIDXCOL.table_id = ForSYSTABCOL.table_id AND ForSYSIDXCOL.column_id = ForSYSTABCOL.column_id JOIN SYS.SYSFOREIGNKEYS ON USER_NAME( PriSYSTAB.creator ) = SYSFOREIGNKEYS.primary_creator AND PriSYSTAB.table_name = SYSFOREIGNKEYS.primary_tname AND USER_NAME( ForSYSTAB.creator ) = SYSFOREIGNKEYS.foreign_creator AND ForSYSTAB.table_name = SYSFOREIGNKEYS.foreign_tname WHERE STRING( USER_NAME( PriSYSTAB.creator ), '.', PriSYSTAB.table_name ) = $objectName ORDER BY ForSYSIDX.index_name, USER_NAME( ForSYSTAB.creator ), ForSYSTAB.table_name;
table.privileges: SELECT USER_NAME( SYSTABLEPERM.grantee ) AS Grantee, USER_NAME( SYSTABLEPERM.grantor ) AS Grantor, CASE SYSTABLEPERM.selectauth WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' END AS SelectAuth, CASE SYSTABLEPERM.insertauth WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' END AS InsertAuth, CASE SYSTABLEPERM.deleteauth WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' END AS DeleteAuth, CASE SYSTABLEPERM.updateauth WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' END AS UpdateAuth, CASE SYSTABLEPERM.alterauth WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' END AS AlterAuth, CASE SYSTABLEPERM.referenceauth WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' END AS ReferenceAuth FROM SYS.SYSTABLEPERM JOIN SYS.SYSTAB ON SYSTABLEPERM.stable_id = SYSTAB.table_id WHERE STRING( USER_NAME( SYSTAB.creator ), '.', SYSTAB.table_name ) = $objectName ORDER BY Grantee, Grantor;

view.columns: SELECT column_name AS Name, base_type_str AS Type FROM SYS.SYSTABCOL JOIN SYS.SYSTABLE ON SYSTABCOL.table_id = SYSTABLE.table_id JOIN SYS.SYSUSER ON SYSTABLE.creator = SYSUSER.user_id WHERE STRING(SYSUSER.user_name, '.', SYSTABLE.table_name) = $objectName ORDER BY SYSTABCOL.column_id;
view.privileges: SELECT USER_NAME( SYSTABLEPERM.grantee ) AS Grantee, USER_NAME( SYSTABLEPERM.grantor ) AS Grantor, CASE SYSTABLEPERM.selectauth WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' END AS SelectAuth, CASE SYSTABLEPERM.insertauth WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' END AS InsertAuth, CASE SYSTABLEPERM.deleteauth WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' END AS DeleteAuth, CASE SYSTABLEPERM.updateauth WHEN 'Y' THEN 'Yes' WHEN 'N' THEN 'No' END AS UpdateAuth FROM SYS.SYSTABLEPERM JOIN SYS.SYSTAB ON SYSTABLEPERM.stable_id = SYSTAB.table_id WHERE STRING( USER_NAME( SYSTAB.creator ), '.', SYSTAB.table_name ) = $objectName ORDER BY Grantee, Grantor;

procedure.privileges: SELECT USER_NAME( SYSPROCPERM.grantee ) AS Grantee, 'Yes' AS ExecuteAuth FROM SYS.SYSPROCPERM JOIN SYS.SYSPROCEDURE ON SYSPROCPERM.proc_id = SYSPROCEDURE.proc_id JOIN SYS.SYSUSER ON SYSPROCEDURE.creator = SYSUSER.user_id WHERE STRING( SYSUSER.user_name, '.', SYSPROCEDURE.proc_name ) = $objectName ORDER BY Grantee;
